_written: 2026-11-02, before any ranking was computed (step 2). Step-1 tables had been viewed (descriptive only).
_source_tables: results/r01_figure_20261102/step1_reorient/snv_footprint.tsv (fp_features A7-mask confident-call significant pairs) plus fp_features effects for the +/-5 bp mask, A10 E1 for caller-free support, Kircher 2019 activity.

pool.pairs: SNV x footprint pairs with fp_features sig == True (mask A7, calls confident)
pool.footprint_size: TF-sized footprints only (length box overlapping 17-45 bp): F04 F07 F10 F13 F15 F18 F21 F22
pool.activity_gate: published activity P < 0.05 in LDLR and the same sign in LDLR.2

panels.activator: sign(footprint D) == sign(activity)  (loss with lower activity, or gain with higher activity)
panels.repressor: sign(footprint D) != sign(activity)  (gain with lower activity, or loss with higher activity)

score_points.confident_support: footprint confident_share >= 0.8: 1 (all pool pairs are already confident-call tests)
score_points.mask_robustness: +/-5 bp mask: significant (fp_features sig, pm5, confident) and same sign: 2; same sign and p < 0.1: 1
score_points.distance: SNV more than 10 bp outside the footprint span: 1 (beyond the near-SNV Hia5 range)
score_points.keeps_its_base: SNV is not 'drops its base' (caller keeps the edited base): 1
score_points.independent_agreement: other alleles at the same position that are themselves in the same panel's pool: 1 each, max 2

ties: broken by smaller A7 confident p
not_scored_reported_only: caller-free support: mean change in inaccessible (unmarked) fraction at testable adenines inside the footprint span, A7 and +/-5 masks (A10 E1)
region_level_candidates: Repeat 3 Sp1 (143-151) is reported from A11 numbers (pooled dose-response), not scored: its footprint evidence is the 10-40 bp call coverage at the site, not an F-box test.
user_guidance_2026-11-02: Repressor panel: prefer a single variant whose TF-sized footprint and activity move in opposite directions (e.g. 68C>T), even with contradicting alleles; show the contradiction.
